docs.title: API documentation
docs.intro: The TutorTrack API is the same REST API our own apps use. Public endpoints accept API keys and OAuth access tokens.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.body: Send Authorization: Bearer <token>. Use an API key for your own scripts, or OAuth2 (authorisation code with PKCE) for apps other organisations connect. Each token has scopes such as clients:read; it can never do more than the person who created it.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.body: Lists are cursor-paginated: follow the next link until it is null. Use page_size (up to 200) to change the page length.

errors.title: Errors
errors.body: Errors use RFC 7807 problem details with type, title, status, detail and, for validation errors, errors per field. 401 means the token is not valid; 403 means a scope or permission is missing.

idempotency.title: Idempotency
idempotency.body: Send an Idempotency-Key header on POST requests to make them safe to retry for 24 hours. Repeating the key with a different body returns 422.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.body: We POST each event as JSON with Webhook-Id, Webhook-Event and Webhook-Signature headers. Compute HMAC-SHA256 with your endpoint secret over the timestamp, a full stop and the raw body, compare it with each v1 value and reject timestamps more than five minutes old. Failed deliveries are retried with backoff for about 72 hours; endpoints failing for three days are disabled. Events can arrive out of order: use occurred_at.

rateLimits.title: Rate limits
rateLimits.body: Each token may make 600 requests a minute with bursts of up to 100 a second. Every response has X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset; when you exceed the limit you get 429 with Retry-After.

versioning.title: Versioning
versioning.body: The major version is in the URL (/api/v1/). Within v1 we only add fields and endpoints. Endpoints being retired send Deprecation and Sunset headers months ahead and appear in the changelog.
